errors.text_span: Eine durchgezogene, schwarze Linie mit Strichmarkierungen
errors.evidence: The description identifies the horizontal reference line at 2% as "durchgezogen" (solid), but it is clearly a dashed line.

errors.text_span: steigt auf 3,1 % des BIP bei x = 1975
errors.evidence: The description claims the green line rises to 3.1% in 1975, but the value shown in the chart is approximately 2.85%. The line never reaches 3.1%.

errors.text_span: fällt auf 2,5 % des BIP bei x = 1980
errors.evidence: The description states the value in 1980 is 2.5%, but the chart shows a value of approximately 2.75%.
The description claims the line is 'roughly constant' until 1995, but the chart clearly shows a steady decrease from approximately 2.3% in 1990 to 1.8% in 1995.

errors.text_span: fällt dann auf 1,9 % des BIP bei x = 2000
errors.evidence: The description states the value in 2000 is 1.9%, but the chart shows a value of approximately 1.6%.

errors.text_span: steigt leicht auf 1,8 % des BIP bei x = 2015
errors.evidence: The description claims the line rises to 1.8% in 2015. In fact, 2015 marks a local minimum for the line, at a value of approximately 1.3%.

errors.text_span: kehrt dann zu 1,9 % des BIP bei x = 2020 zurück
errors.evidence: The description states the value is 1.9% in 2020, but the chart shows a value of approximately 1.5% at that point.
